findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties.
findings.comment: Observed that there was not a PIC present who demonstrated knowledge on proper warewashing procedures. When asked, PIC explained that the 2-compartment sink is used for warewashing, with wash and rinse happening in the two basins, then the sink is emptied and reset for sanitizing. A 3-compartment sink is available for warewashing in the meat room. All warewashing should take place there, where one basin each can be designated for wash, rinse, and sanitize. Ensure that the PIC demonstrates knowledge of correct sanitizing procedures.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.11(C)(11) Demonstration. Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, during inspections and upon request the PERSON IN CHARGE shall demonstrate to the REGULATORY AUTHORITY knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of the HAZARD Analysis and CRITICAL CONTROL POINT principles, and the requirements of this Code. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall demonstrate this knowledge by: (C) Responding correctly to the inspector's questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include: (11) Explaining correct procedures for cleaning and SANITIZING UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT. [Pf]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed that there was a not a staff member who had a Certified Food Protection Manager certification on the premises. PIC was notified. Ensure that a CFPM is on the premises at all times when food preparation can occur.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: 1ST REPEAT: Observed ground meat stored over whole meat, and raw meat was stored above cured ready-to-eat meat in the deli meat 4-door display cooler. CORRECTED: PICs were notified and the meats in that cooler were moved so that RTE meat was stored above whole meat, and whole meat was stored above ground meat. Inspector provided educational handouts about storage order. Meats of different final cooking temperatures can be stored side-by-side as long as they are kept separate and they are not stored improperly over another item. Ensure that animal proteins are always stored according to internal cooking temperatures to avoid contamination: ready-to-eat foods (no cooking required/ pre-cooked), above whole meat (145 F), above ground meat (155 F), above chicken and turkey (165 F).
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food. [P]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas that have an accumulation of soils:
(i) the walk-in cooler fans are dusty.
(ii) the walk-in freezer has significant ice accumulation.
PIC was notified that these areas need to be cleaned with enough frequency to prevent an accumulation of soil residues so that they are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that the trash receptacle in the women’s bathroom does not have a lid. PIC was notified that all bathroom stalls that are used by women have to have a covered trash receptacle. Ensure that all toilet rooms used by women have a covered trash can.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that the coving along the wall in the meat department has come away from the wall and needs to be repaired. PIC was notified. Ensure that walls are coved and sealed to the floor.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(B) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (B) The floors in FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain, and the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. [C]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed the facility had dented cans on the shelf. The inspector removed the dented cans from the shelf during the inspection. The PIC was instructed to remind employees about the importance of removing dented cans. Ensure that food packages are always in good condition to protect the integrity of food.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed raw chicken stored over raw beef in the meat walk-in cooler. The PIC was shown the incorrect storage order during the inspection and they moved the raw chicken onto a bottom shelf. The PIC mentioned labeling the bottom shelf for chicken storage only. Additionally a storage order handout was provided for further education. Ensure that raw meats are always stored according to internal cooking temperatures to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed there is not test strips at the facility to measure the concentration of sanitizing solutions. The facility uses both bleach (Cl) and quat to sanitize, so both test strips are required. Ensure there is always test strips at the facility for measuring sanitizing solution concentrations. There will be a follow-up on 08/22/2024 to check on test strips.                               

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed there is a drip in the triple sink in the meat room and in the walk-in cooler in the meat room. The drip in the walk-in cooler is not dripping near any food. The PIC is aware and they are in the process of scheduling maintenance. There will be a follow-up on 08/22/2024 to check that the leaks have been repaired. Ensure that plumbing systems are maintained in good repair.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.
